one_line: Nvidia board probes CEO over spy-linked affair as labs ship new models and EU targets AI relationships.

themes.title: Nvidia board probes CEO over spy-linked affair
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. officials allege is a Chinese spy. The probe follows a Commerce chip-smuggling case against Megaspeed that was moved to the DOJ after Nvidia contacted the agency.

stories.headline: Nvidia board launches investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admits affair
Nvidia board launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy plot
Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy
Nvidia intervention leads to Commerce chip smuggling probe being moved to DOJ

themes.title: New models and agent apps ship
themes.text: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, Meta shipped its lightweight Muse Ember reasoning model, and DeepSeek reported its Harness agent app reached 1.54 million daily active users using about 92 trillion tokens a day.

stories.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 models
Meta releases Muse Ember lightweight reasoning model
DeepSeek says Harness agent app reached 1.54M daily active users

themes.title: Regulators and officials weigh in on AI
themes.text: The EU's proposed Digital Fairness Act would require companies to let adults disable addictive features and target AI systems that simulate relationships, while Trump claimed the DOJ threatened a top AI executive with arrest over misconduct.

stories.headline:
EU's proposed Digital Fairness Act targets addictive features and AI
relationships
US AI safety center officials asked to informally report to White House
Trump says DOJ threatened top AI executive with jail over misconduct

themes.title: Compute and data center buildout continues
themes.text: Google announced TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max systems, ByteDance is considering a larger data center phase in Brazil, former DOE staffers raised $130 million for modular data center firm Mavria, and NVIDIA expanded its sovereign AI collaboration with South Korea.

ByteDance considers data center expansion in Ceará, Brazil
Former US DOE staffers launch modular data center firm Mavria with $130M
